queryAndRequestReview: English and French first-party discovery was performed. The official Ministry, directory, service-procedure, and BIC routes were fetched or inspected. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS verification exception was used.
